---
title: "Module 12: Spatial cell-cell communication analysis with CellChat"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-12"
---

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# MODULE 12 — Spatial CellChat signaling analysis
#==============================================================================
#
# Purpose:
#   Infer global ligand-receptor signaling between spatial transcriptional
#   identities.
#
# CellChat identities:
#   - inferCNV malignant-enriched spots -> "Malignant-enriched"
#   - remaining spots -> SingleR predicted spot identity
#
# Large identity groups are downsampled before CellChat inference to reduce
# dominance by highly represented spatial identities.
#
# Important:
#   Visium spots contain mixtures of cells. CellChat groups therefore represent
#   predominant spatial transcriptional identities rather than pure cell types.
#
#   CellChat identifies potential signaling relationships from expression and
#   prior ligand-receptor knowledge. These results do not demonstrate physical
#   cell-cell contact, receptor activation, or signaling causality.
#
# Input:
#   data/processed/spatial/spatial_tumor_final_infercnv_singleR.rds
#
# Output:
#   CellChat object, interaction/pathway tables, downsampling summary,
#   and global signaling figures.
#==============================================================================


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Setup
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(CellChat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(here)
})

set.seed(1234)


# Analysis settings

spatial_assay <- "Spatial"

singleR_column <- "predicted_spot_identity"
malignancy_column <- "malignancy_annotation"
cellchat_group_column <- "CellChat_identity"

malignant_label <- "Malignant-enriched"
uncertain_label <- "Uncertain"

minimum_spots_per_group <- 10
max_spots_per_identity <- 1000

communication_mean_type <- "truncatedMean"
communication_trim <- 0.10

top_n_pathways <- 20


# Repository paths

processed_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "spatial"
)

cellchat_object_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "spatial",
  "cellchat"
)

results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "spatial",
  "cellchat"
)

figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "spatial",
  "cellchat"
)


dir.create(
  cellchat_object_directory,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

dir.create(
  results_directory,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

dir.create(
  figure_directory,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


input_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "spatial_tumor_final_infercnv_singleR.rds"
)

cellchat_object_file <- file.path(
  cellchat_object_directory,
  "spatial_CellChat_global.rds"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Load spatial object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!file.exists(input_file)) {
  stop(
    "Input spatial object was not found: ",
    input_file
  )
}


spatial_cellchat <- readRDS(
  input_file
)


if (!spatial_assay %in% names(spatial_cellchat@assays)) {
  stop(
    "Spatial assay was not found."
  )
}


required_metadata <- c(
  singleR_column,
  malignancy_column
)

missing_metadata <- setdiff(
  required_metadata,
  colnames(spatial_cellchat@meta.data)
)

if (length(missing_metadata) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Required metadata missing: ",
    paste(
      missing_metadata,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


DefaultAssay(
  spatial_cellchat
) <- spatial_assay


message(
  "Loaded ",
  ncol(spatial_cellchat),
  " spatial spots."
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Define CellChat identities
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Malignant-enriched inferCNV spots form their own signaling group.
# Remaining spots retain their predominant SingleR identity.

spatial_cellchat$CellChat_identity <- ifelse(
  spatial_cellchat@meta.data[[malignancy_column]] == malignant_label,
  malignant_label,
  as.character(
    spatial_cellchat@meta.data[[singleR_column]]
  )
)


# Remove spots without a usable identity.

valid_identity <- !is.na(
  spatial_cellchat$CellChat_identity
) &
  spatial_cellchat$CellChat_identity != "" &
  spatial_cellchat$CellChat_identity != uncertain_label


spatial_cellchat <- subset(
  spatial_cellchat,
  cells = colnames(spatial_cellchat)[valid_identity]
)


# Remove identities represented by fewer than the minimum number of spots.

identity_counts <- table(
  spatial_cellchat$CellChat_identity
)


valid_groups <- names(
  identity_counts[
    identity_counts >= minimum_spots_per_group
  ]
)


spatial_cellchat <- subset(
  spatial_cellchat,
  cells = colnames(spatial_cellchat)[
    spatial_cellchat$CellChat_identity %in% valid_groups
  ]
)


spatial_cellchat$CellChat_identity <- droplevels(
  factor(
    spatial_cellchat$CellChat_identity
  )
)


if (length(levels(spatial_cellchat$CellChat_identity)) < 2) {
  stop(
    "Fewer than two CellChat identities remain after filtering."
  )
}


message(
  ncol(spatial_cellchat),
  " eligible spots across ",
  length(levels(spatial_cellchat$CellChat_identity)),
  " CellChat identities."
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Downsample large CellChat identities
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Large identity groups are capped at 1,000 spots.
# Smaller groups are retained in full.

sampling_metadata <- spatial_cellchat@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(
    "spot"
  )


counts_before <- sampling_metadata %>%
  dplyr::count(
    CellChat_identity,
    name = "spots_available"
  )


set.seed(1234)


selected_spots <- sampling_metadata %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    CellChat_identity
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(
    ~ {

      if (nrow(.x) > max_spots_per_identity) {

        dplyr::slice_sample(
          .x,
          n = max_spots_per_identity
        )

      } else {

        .x

      }

    }
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::pull(
    spot
  )


spatial_cellchat <- subset(
  spatial_cellchat,
  cells = selected_spots
)


spatial_cellchat$CellChat_identity <- droplevels(
  factor(
    spatial_cellchat$CellChat_identity
  )
)


counts_after <- spatial_cellchat@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(
    "spot"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(
    CellChat_identity,
    name = "spots_used"
  )


downsampling_summary <- counts_before %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    counts_after,
    by = "CellChat_identity"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    spots_used = dplyr::coalesce(
      spots_used,
      0L
    ),
    fraction_used = spots_used / spots_available
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(spots_available)
  )


print(
  downsampling_summary
)


write.csv(
  downsampling_summary,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_CellChat_downsampling_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


message(
  sum(downsampling_summary$spots_available),
  " eligible spots reduced to ",
  sum(downsampling_summary$spots_used),
  " spots after downsampling."
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Plot downsampling summary
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

downsampling_plot_data <- downsampling_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(
    CellChat_identity,
    spots_available,
    spots_used
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      spots_available,
      spots_used
    ),
    names_to = "dataset",
    values_to = "n_spots"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dataset = dplyr::recode(
      dataset,
      spots_available = "Before downsampling",
      spots_used = "Used for CellChat"
    )
  )


downsampling_plot <- ggplot(
  downsampling_plot_data,
  aes(
    x = reorder(
      CellChat_identity,
      n_spots
    ),
    y = n_spots,
    fill = dataset
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = "dodge"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "CellChat identity representation",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of spatial spots",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 12
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "top"
  )


print(
  downsampling_plot
)


ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_CellChat_downsampling_summary.png"
  ),
  downsampling_plot,
  width = 9,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Prepare Spatial expression
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spatial_layers <- SeuratObject::Layers(
  spatial_cellchat[[spatial_assay]]
)

count_layers <- grep(
  "^counts",
  spatial_layers,
  value = TRUE
)


if (length(count_layers) > 1) {

  spatial_cellchat <- SeuratObject::JoinLayers(
    spatial_cellchat,
    assay = spatial_assay
  )
}


# Independently log-normalize the Spatial assay for CellChat.

spatial_cellchat <- Seurat::NormalizeData(
  spatial_cellchat,
  assay = spatial_assay,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor = 10000,
  verbose = FALSE
)


cellchat_expression <- SeuratObject::LayerData(
  spatial_cellchat,
  assay = spatial_assay,
  layer = "data"
)


cellchat_metadata <- spatial_cellchat@meta.data[
  colnames(cellchat_expression),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Run CellChat
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cellchat <- CellChat::createCellChat(
  object = cellchat_expression,
  meta = cellchat_metadata,
  group.by = cellchat_group_column
)


cellchat@DB <- CellChat::CellChatDB.mouse


cellchat <- CellChat::subsetData(
  cellchat
)


cellchat <- CellChat::identifyOverExpressedGenes(
  cellchat
)


cellchat <- CellChat::identifyOverExpressedInteractions(
  cellchat
)


cellchat <- CellChat::computeCommunProb(
  object = cellchat,
  type = communication_mean_type,
  trim = communication_trim,
  raw.use = TRUE,
  population.size = FALSE,
  distance.use = FALSE,
  seed.use = 1234
)


cellchat <- CellChat::filterCommunication(
  cellchat,
  min.cells = minimum_spots_per_group
)


cellchat <- CellChat::computeCommunProbPathway(
  cellchat
)


cellchat <- CellChat::aggregateNet(
  cellchat
)


cellchat <- CellChat::netAnalysis_computeCentrality(
  cellchat,
  slot.name = "netP"
)


message(
  "CellChat inference complete."
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Export interaction results
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cellchat_interactions <- CellChat::subsetCommunication(
  cellchat
)


write.csv(
  cellchat_interactions,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_CellChat_interactions.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


interaction_summary <- cellchat_interactions %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    source,
    target
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    interaction_number = dplyr::n(),
    interaction_strength = sum(
      prob,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


write.csv(
  interaction_summary,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_CellChat_sender_receiver_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Rank signaling pathways
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

pathway_information_flow <- apply(
  cellchat@netP$prob,
  3,
  sum,
  na.rm = TRUE
)


pathway_summary <- data.frame(
  pathway = names(pathway_information_flow),
  information_flow = as.numeric(pathway_information_flow),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    information_flow > 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(information_flow)
  )


top_pathway_summary <- pathway_summary %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(
    n = top_n_pathways
  )


top_pathways <- top_pathway_summary$pathway


write.csv(
  pathway_summary,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_CellChat_pathway_information_flow.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


write.csv(
  top_pathway_summary,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_CellChat_top_pathways.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


print(
  top_pathway_summary
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Global signaling networks
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

group_sizes <- as.numeric(
  table(cellchat@idents)
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10A. Number of interactions
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

png(
  file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_CellChat_interaction_number_circle.png"
  ),
  width = 3000,
  height = 3000,
  res = 300
)

CellChat::netVisual_circle(
  cellchat@net$count,
  vertex.weight = group_sizes,
  weight.scale = TRUE,
  label.edge = FALSE,
  title.name = "Number of interactions"
)

dev.off()


CellChat::netVisual_circle(
  cellchat@net$count,
  vertex.weight = group_sizes,
  weight.scale = TRUE,
  label.edge = FALSE,
  title.name = "Number of interactions"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10B. Interaction strength
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

png(
  file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_CellChat_interaction_strength_circle.png"
  ),
  width = 3000,
  height = 3000,
  res = 300
)

CellChat::netVisual_circle(
  cellchat@net$weight,
  vertex.weight = group_sizes,
  weight.scale = TRUE,
  label.edge = FALSE,
  title.name = "Interaction strength"
)

dev.off()


CellChat::netVisual_circle(
  cellchat@net$weight,
  vertex.weight = group_sizes,
  weight.scale = TRUE,
  label.edge = FALSE,
  title.name = "Interaction strength"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10C. Number of interactions heatmap
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

interaction_count_heatmap <- CellChat::netVisual_heatmap(
  cellchat,
  measure = "count",
  color.heatmap = "Reds"
)


ComplexHeatmap::draw(
  interaction_count_heatmap
)


png(
  file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_CellChat_interaction_number_heatmap.png"
  ),
  width = 3000,
  height = 2600,
  res = 300
)

ComplexHeatmap::draw(
  interaction_count_heatmap
)

dev.off()


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10D. Interaction strength heatmap
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

interaction_strength_heatmap <- CellChat::netVisual_heatmap(
  cellchat,
  measure = "weight",
  color.heatmap = "Reds"
)


ComplexHeatmap::draw(
  interaction_strength_heatmap
)


png(
  file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_CellChat_interaction_strength_heatmap.png"
  ),
  width = 3000,
  height = 2600,
  res = 300
)

ComplexHeatmap::draw(
  interaction_strength_heatmap
)

dev.off()


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10E. Signaling-role scatter
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

signaling_role_scatter <- CellChat::netAnalysis_signalingRole_scatter(
  cellchat
)


print(
  signaling_role_scatter
)


ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_CellChat_signaling_role_scatter.png"
  ),
  signaling_role_scatter,
  width = 9,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Global pathway signaling
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# All detected pathways are retained in the CellChat object and result tables.
# Only the strongest pathways are displayed to keep figures readable.


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11A. Top pathway information flow
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

top_pathway_plot_data <- top_pathway_summary %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pathway = factor(
      pathway,
      levels = rev(pathway)
    )
  )


pathway_information_plot <- ggplot(
  top_pathway_plot_data,
  aes(
    x = information_flow,
    y = pathway
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Top signaling pathways",
    x = "Global information flow",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 12
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )


print(
  pathway_information_plot
)


ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_CellChat_top_pathway_information_flow.png"
  ),
  pathway_information_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11B. Outgoing signaling heatmap
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

outgoing_heatmap <- CellChat::netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(
  cellchat,
  pattern = "outgoing",
  signaling = top_pathways,
  title = "Outgoing signaling"
)


ComplexHeatmap::draw(
  outgoing_heatmap
)


png(
  file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_CellChat_top_pathways_outgoing_heatmap.png"
  ),
  width = 3200,
  height = 2800,
  res = 300
)

ComplexHeatmap::draw(
  outgoing_heatmap
)

dev.off()


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11C. Incoming signaling heatmap
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

incoming_heatmap <- CellChat::netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(
  cellchat,
  pattern = "incoming",
  signaling = top_pathways,
  title = "Incoming signaling"
)


ComplexHeatmap::draw(
  incoming_heatmap
)


png(
  file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_CellChat_top_pathways_incoming_heatmap.png"
  ),
  width = 3200,
  height = 2800,
  res = 300
)

ComplexHeatmap::draw(
  incoming_heatmap
)

dev.off()

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Representative PTN signaling pathway
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Examine PTN signaling as a representative pathway from the spatial CellChat
# analysis.
#
# Outputs:
#   - PTN cell-identity chord diagram
#   - PTN ligand-receptor contribution plot
#   - PTN source-target interaction table
#
# Important:
#   Spatial CellChat identities represent predominant transcriptional
#   identities of Visium spots rather than purified individual cell types.
#   These results therefore represent inferred signaling relationships between
#   spatial transcriptional populations.


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12A. Confirm PTN pathway is present
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

representative_pathway <- "PTN"


if (!representative_pathway %in% cellchat@netP$pathways) {

  stop(
    "PTN signaling pathway was not detected in the spatial CellChat analysis."
  )
}


message(
  "Analyzing representative CellChat pathway: ",
  representative_pathway
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12B. Export PTN pathway interactions
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

ptn_interactions <- CellChat::subsetCommunication(
  cellchat,
  signaling = representative_pathway
)


print(
  ptn_interactions
)


write.csv(
  ptn_interactions,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_CellChat_PTN_interactions.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


message(
  "PTN pathway contains ",
  nrow(ptn_interactions),
  " inferred source-target interactions."
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12C. PTN signaling chord diagram
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# The chord diagram summarizes inferred PTN communication between spatial
# CellChat identities. Ribbon width represents relative communication strength.

png(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_CellChat_PTN_signaling_chord.png"
  ),
  width = 3200,
  height = 3200,
  res = 400
)


CellChat::netVisual_chord_cell(
  cellchat,
  signaling = representative_pathway,
  title.name = "PTN signaling pathway network"
)


dev.off()


message(
  "Saved PTN signaling chord diagram."
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12D. PTN ligand-receptor contribution
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Quantify the relative contribution of individual ligand-receptor
# interactions to the inferred PTN pathway.

ptn_contribution_plot <- CellChat::netAnalysis_contribution(
  cellchat,
  signaling = representative_pathway
)


print(
  ptn_contribution_plot
)


ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_CellChat_PTN_ligand_receptor_contribution.png"
  ),
  plot = ptn_contribution_plot,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)


message(
  "Saved PTN ligand-receptor contribution plot."
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12E. Summarize PTN sender-receiver communication
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Aggregate PTN communication probabilities across ligand-receptor pairs to
# identify the strongest source-target relationships.

ptn_sender_receiver_summary <- ptn_interactions %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    source,
    target
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_interactions = dplyr::n(),
    communication_strength = sum(
      prob,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(communication_strength)
  )


print(
  ptn_sender_receiver_summary
)


write.csv(
  ptn_sender_receiver_summary,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_CellChat_PTN_sender_receiver_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12F. Report strongest inferred PTN relationships
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

message(
  "Top inferred PTN source-target relationships:"
)


print(
  ptn_sender_receiver_summary %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(
      n = 10
    )
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. Save analysis parameters and CellChat object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cellchat_parameters <- data.frame(

  parameter = c(
    "spatial_assay",
    "SingleR_identity",
    "malignancy_annotation",
    "malignant_label",
    "minimum_spots_per_group",
    "maximum_spots_per_identity",
    "random_seed",
    "normalization",
    "normalization_scale_factor",
    "communication_mean",
    "trim",
    "raw_use",
    "population_size",
    "distance_use",
    "top_pathways_displayed"
  ),

  value = c(
    spatial_assay,
    singleR_column,
    malignancy_column,
    malignant_label,
    minimum_spots_per_group,
    max_spots_per_identity,
    1234,
    "LogNormalize",
    10000,
    communication_mean_type,
    communication_trim,
    TRUE,
    FALSE,
    FALSE,
    top_n_pathways
  ),

  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


write.csv(
  cellchat_parameters,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_CellChat_parameters.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


saveRDS(
  cellchat,
  cellchat_object_file,
  compress = TRUE
)


message(
  "Module 12 complete: ",
  ncol(spatial_cellchat),
  " spatial spots across ",
  length(levels(cellchat@idents)),
  " CellChat identities and ",
  nrow(pathway_summary),
  " detected signaling pathways."
)
```
